proposed_widenings.name: PassiveMechanics.auraScope
proposed_widenings.justification: The Aura of Courage grants frightened immunity to the paladin AND all allies within a 10-ft emanation. PassiveMechanics has no attachment or area scope concept — its grants are implicitly bearer-only. Encoding just the bearer's immunity produces a provably false trace that omits the defining mechanic of the feature.
proposed_widenings.evidence: You and your allies have Immunity to the Frightened condition while in your Aura of Protection. If a Frightened ally enters the aura, that condition has no effect on that ally while there.

notes: PassiveMechanics and grant_condition_immunity both now exist (gaps from the older aura_of_devotion proposal were since closed). The sole remaining gap is that PassiveMechanics has no optional area/aura attachment to express 'grants apply to friendly creatures within N-ft emanation of the bearer'. An analogous concept exists for spells (ongoing_effect with area attachment + occupantDispositionFilter: friendly_to_source), but is unavailable to class features. A new optional field on PassiveMechanics — e.g. auraScope: { kind: 'emanation', radiusFeet: number, occupants: 'friendly_to_source' } — would close this gap and cover all paladin aura features (Aura of Protection L6, Aura of Courage L10, Aura Expansion L18, subclass auras).
